title: Do Rule-Based Tools Help LLMs Translate Endangered Uralic Languages in the Prompt or over MCP?
abstract: arXiv:2611.19439v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Komi-Zyrian, Moksha, Erzya and Udmurt have mature rule-based resources, among them finite-state analysers, constraint grammars and bilingual dictionaries, which language models do not use. We ask whether giving a model access to these resources improves machine translation from the four languages into English, and whether it matters how the access is provided: as analyses computed in advance and written into the prompt, or as tools that the model calls itself through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We evaluate manually: an expert linguist read every English output of the strongest model under three conditions, 816 sentences in all, accepted or rejected each one, and named the main error in every rejected translation. With the analyses in the prompt, the number of accepted translations rises from 13 to 43 out of 272; with the tools attached it rises to 55. The gain comes from the bilingual dictionary. translated_title: 基于规则的工具能否帮助大语言模型翻译濒危的乌拉尔语言：写入提示词还是通过MCP调用？
translated_abstract: 科米-济良语、莫克沙语、埃尔齐亚语和乌德穆尔特语拥有成熟的基于规则的语言资源，包括有限状态分析器、约束语法和双语词典，但语言模型并未使用这些资源。我们探究让模型访问这些资源能否改善从这四种语言到英语的机器翻译，以及访问方式是否有影响：是将预先计算好的分析结果写入提示词，还是让模型通过模型上下文协议（MCP）自行调用这些资源作为工具。我们采用人工评估：一位专家语言学家阅读了最强模型在三种条件下的全部英文输出，共816个句子，对每个句子判断接受或拒绝，并为每个被拒绝的译文指出主要错误。将分析结果放入提示词后，被接受的译文数量从272句中的13句提升至43句；而附加工具后提升至55句。这一提升主要来自双语词典。对于乌德穆尔特语，其词典有……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究的核心贡献是首次系统评估了为大语言模型提供成熟的规则语言学资源的两种方式，发现通过MCP让模型自主调用工具（尤其是双语词典）比在提示词中预先写入分析结果更能显著提升濒危乌拉尔语言到英语的机器翻译质量。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates two ways of giving LLMs access to mature rule-based linguistic resources, showing that self-invoked MCP tools—especially bilingual dictionaries—improve machine translation from endangered Uralic languages into English more than pre-computed analyses written into the prompt.
